title: Army Signal Regiment
intro: Follow the signal-support organization described in PAM 6-0102. These are subordinate-unit types and missions, not a current personnel roster.

sources.label: Signal Operations · printed page 7 · figure 1.3 and paragraph 0130

notes: Seven subordinate-unit categories are listed. Figure 1.3 depicts eleven signal battalions. These are 2022 source-edition unit counts, not current personnel strengths.
Officer and enlisted strengths are not stated on the cited page.

tree.title: Army Signal Regiment
tree.role: Signal support and services for the Philippine Army.

children.title: Headquarters & Headquarters Company
children.role: Command, control and administration.

children.title: Command Signal Battalion
children.role: Signal support to HPA post units and other PA units in NCR.

children.title: Network Enterprise Technology Battalion
children.role: Operate, maintain, enhance and secure PA IT infrastructure.

children.title: Signal Battalion
children.role: Signal support to infantry division and brigade headquarters. Figure 1.3 depicts eleven signal battalions in the 15 April 2022 edition.

children.title: Signal Installation & Maintenance Battalion
children.role: Signal installation and maintenance support.

children.title: Cyber Battalion
children.role: Cybersecurity operations to protect PA cyber assets.

children.title: The Signal School
children.role: Specialized communications, electronics and information-systems education.

title: Infantry rifle company
intro: Explore the company down to its nine-person squads. Quantities beside branches show how many subunits the parent contains.

sources.label: Infantry Company Operations · printed page 2 · company and platoon
Infantry Company Operations · printed page 3 · squad and fire teams
Infantry Company Operations · printed pages 5–7 · key personnel

notes: Nine personnel per squad and four per fire team are explicit source counts. Three squads contain 27 people, but this excludes platoon HQ and the attached medic.
The designated marksman is not an additional person. The cited pages do not explicitly tabulate officer/EP totals.

tree.title: Infantry rifle company
tree.role: One headquarters platoon and three rifle platoons.

children.title: Command section
children.role: Company commander and staff. Command and control, resupply and casualty evacuation coordination.

children.title: Anti-armor section
children.role: Company anti-armor support.

children.title: Mortar section
children.role: Immediate indirect-fire support.

children.title: Rifle platoon
children.role: The source specifies three squads. The full headquarters strength and officer/EP split are not confirmed here.

children.title: Platoon headquarters
children.role: Leader, sergeant, radio operator, assault-weapon gunner, ammunition bearer and machine-gun personnel. The wording about machine-gun crews is ambiguous, so no total is calculated.

children.title: Rifle squad
children.role: One squad leader and two four-person fire teams.

children.title: Fire Team A
children.role: Four positions. The rifleman also serves as the squad designated marksman.

children.title: Rifleman / squad designated marksman
children.role: The marksman occupies an existing rifleman position.

children.title: Fire Team B
children.role: Four positions.

children.title: Rifleman
children.role: Rifleman position in Fire Team B.

children.title: Medical aid-man
children.role: Attached from the battalion medical platoon. Kept separate from organic personnel.

roles.title: Company commander
roles.role: Responsible for employment, training, administration, personnel management and sustainment.

roles.title: Executive officer
roles.role: Second in command. Assists planning and coordinates sustainment.

roles.title: Platoon leader
roles.role: Responsible for the platoon’s employment, training, administration and logistics.

roles.title: First sergeant
roles.role: Senior company NCO. Supervises routine operations and advises the commander.

roles.title: Platoon sergeant
roles.role: Advises the platoon leader and supervises administration, logistics and maintenance.

roles.title: Communications sergeant / senior radio operator
roles.role: Supervises operation, maintenance and installation of organic communications.

roles.title: Radio operator
roles.role: Operates and maintains the assigned radio.
